_doc: Districts of Caldera (WorldManager). customers = archetype weights; map = normalized map position.

districts.name: The Sump
districts.label: UNDERCITY
districts.description: Sublevels 1-6 under the old flood walls. Pumps that never stop, rooms rented by the hour, and nobody asks where the blood came from.
districts.architecture: Poured concrete, flood stains, stacked container housing, pump stations.
districts.lighting: Single bulbs, failing fluorescents, the sodium glow of the pump houses.
districts.population: Pump crews, runaways, addicts, Rustline lookouts.

districts.name: Furnace Line
districts.label: INDUSTRIAL BELT
districts.description: Smelters and print-foundries ringing the caldera wall. Shifts run around the clock and so do the injuries.
districts.architecture: Riveted steel, I-beams, gantries, corrugated sheds, slag heaps.
districts.lighting: Orange furnace glow, caged sodium lamps, welding flashes.
districts.population: Foundry crews, haulers, union bosses, contract security.

districts.name: Glow Strip
districts.label: NIGHT MARKET
districts.description: A canal of stalls under tarps, where chrome changes hands three times before dawn. The Undermarket's front window.
districts.architecture: Tarp roofs, shipping crates, strung cable, stall cages.
districts.lighting: Hand-painted signs, a few dying tubes, lanterns, phone screens.
districts.population: Stallholders, smugglers, performers, tourists slumming it.

districts.name: Velvet Tier
districts.label: ENTERTAINMENT
districts.description: Clubs, sensory parlours and private rooms stacked over the canal. Everyone wants to look new by midnight.
districts.architecture: Mirrored cladding over old brick, velvet ropes, service corridors.
districts.lighting: Warm club light leaking from doors, cheap holo-billboards, dark alleys behind.
districts.population: Performers, bouncers, dealers, executives off the record.

districts.name: Old Caldera
districts.label: OLD CITY
districts.description: The original city above the flood line: tenements, churches turned clinics, families who remember the drowning.
districts.architecture: Brick tenements, iron balconies, tiled stairwells, patched domes.
districts.lighting: Warm windows, old streetlamps, the occasional cold clinic tube.
districts.population: Old families, retirees, fixers, signal jockeys in rented attics.

districts.name: Meridian Heights
districts.label: CORPORATE
districts.description: The arcology terraces. Clean air is billed by the lungful and security knows your face before you do.
districts.architecture: White composite, glass bridges, checkpoints, sealed gardens.
districts.lighting: Cold, even daylight panels; nothing is ever dark, nothing is ever warm.
districts.population: Executives, contract staff, security, Lyra researchers.

districts.name: Lyra Exclusion Zone
districts.label: RESTRICTED ZONE
districts.description: A quarantined research campus on the drowned district's edge. Officially a biohazard site. Unofficially, where THREAD was grown.
districts.architecture: Sealed labs, decontamination locks, flooded lower floors, fences.
districts.lighting: Emergency strips, cold lab light, searchlights on the water.
districts.population: Lyra staff, contractors, test subjects who never left.
